summary.intent: Build the release recovery mechanism now rather than merging open PRs first: a `callisto release pending` discovery command that finds unfinished releases from committed decisions, replacing the label scripts and queue.
summary.outcome: Implemented `pending_releases` discovery in a new pending.rs plus a `callisto release pending` CLI command (text and JSON output) with six passing tests, spec and docs updates, and a changeset. Full CI passed after a clippy fix, and the work was shipped as its own PR. The workflow switch, `--from` execute integration and deletion of the label scripts and queue remain.

repo: Release architecture publishes to registries first, then tags, then creates and publishes the forge release. A release is therefore complete when every package in its committed decision has its tag and the product's GitHub release is published.
Completion can be checked cheaply by reading the decision at each candidate commit with `git show`, with no checkout, per-commit plan or artifact digests.

`releases_tagged_at` already maps tags to decision entries, and `TagIndex`, `TagName` and the GitHub release lookup in provider/forge.rs were reusable building blocks. `tag_of_version` had to be made crate-visible.
The decision file path is passed explicitly elsewhere, so the new command defaults to `.callisto/release-decision.json` with an override.
Release specs live in docs/specs/release.json, which has a criterion field convention and sequential rerun spec ids. Recovery docs are in docs/releasing.md. Changes also need a changeset.
Full CI includes clippy and rejected the first version of pending.rs until a lint was fixed.
Work happens in the worktree .claude/worktrees/smoke-main, and many small PRs (#389-#396) are open against main.

code.finding: New discovery module: reads each release commit's committed decision via git, checks every package's tag and the GitHub release's published state, and returns pending releases. Tests cover finished, unfinished, oldest-first ordering, stop-at-first-finished, `--from` and unknown `--from`.
Added the handler for the `release pending` subcommand with text and JSON output and no new report type.

workflow: Validating the new command against the real repository (expecting 0.15.0 as the one pending release) was used as the most meaningful end-to-end test.
Checking the existing test fixture before writing tests allowed reuse without new scaffolding.
Splitting the discovery command into its own PR keeps the larger workflow switch reviewable.

friction: Building on top of unmerged PRs (#392, #395, #396) that touch reusable code risks conflicts, since the user chose to build before merging.
The first CI run failed on a clippy complaint in pending.rs and needed a fix and rerun.
Several lookups were needed to find the CLI enum, dispatch, import block and decision path default across crates.
open_items: Switch the release workflow to use `release pending`, plus the existing execute path against the oldest pending release, with `--from <sha>` as the escape for a stuck one.
Delete the label scripts and the queue.
The 0.15.0 recovery is still waiting on the user's go; merging #391 first would let the tap pick it up automatically.
Small tidy-ups skipped on purpose: folding the two prepared structs, merging the two roster loops, and the five-derivations point.
